onboarding.voiceWelcome: Akwaaba wɔ SafePay. Wowɔ fie krataafa so. Pia Speak Balance mpɛn mmienu na wote w’akaunt mu sika, anaa fa MoMo adwuma no di dwuma.
onboarding.welcomeBody: Akwaaba. SafePay ma wote wo sika, na wo PIN rennsɛ da. Nhyehyɛeɛ yi ti kakra. Fa wo nne anaa wo nsa yɛ.
onboarding.micBody: Microphone no ho akwannya? SafePay te nne bere a app no rebue, enti wobɛtumi aka wo ahyɛdeɛ.
onboarding.micGranted: Microphone no agye tom. SafePay betumi ate wo nne.
onboarding.micDenied: Ɛnnɛ nnyɛ hwee. Akyire yi wubɛtumi agye tom wɔ Settings mu.
onboarding.micPermanent: Wɔatow microphone no agu SafePay. Bu no mu wɔ wo fono settings mu, na san bue SafePay.
onboarding.listeningBody: Bere a SafePay rebue no, microphone no da so. Ɛnsɛ sɛ wuhu bɔtɔn bi. Ka gyae anaagyɛ stop, na SafePay abu so.
onboarding.nextHint: Bɔ mmienu kɔ anamɔn a ɛdi so
onboarding.skipHint: Bɔ mmienu twa anamɔn no mu
onboarding.contactsBody: Akyire yi, sɛ woka din te sɛ Ama a, SafePay betumi ahunu ne fono nomba. Nea edi kan no, ɛbɛbisa wo kwan. Wo contacts da wo fono mu pɛpɛɛpɛ.
onboarding.talkbackTitle: Sɛn na wupɛ sɛ wodwo krataafa no so?
onboarding.talkbackBody: Sɛn na wupɛ sɛ wodwo krataafa no so?
onboarding.srOn: Wo screen reader no resi so.
onboarding.srOff: Wo screen reader no aso. SafePay bɛka ne ho.
onboarding.micTestBody: Sɛ wo nne. Sɛ nhwɛso: SafePay, ɛte sɛn?
onboarding.micTestRetry: Mantie hwee. Ka bio, yɛ den kakra.
onboarding.voiceTestOk: Ɛyɛ. Wobɛtumi asesa nne so bere biara.
onboarding.voiceTestNo: Yɛ nne no den, na tie bio.
onboarding.bioBody: SafePay gye dwuma biara to mu de wo nsa nkyerɛwde. Wo PIN rennsɛ da.
onboarding.bioNone: Wo fono yi nnisa nkyerɛwde nnihɔ. SafePay de wo nne bɛgye to mu.
onboarding.bioNotEnrolled: Wonsa nkyerɛwde nnsi hɔ dada. Fa ka ho wɔ wo fono settings, Security ase. SafePay bɛde wo nne agye tomu kɔsi ɛno.
onboarding.bioSuccess: Nsa nkyerɛwde no agye to mu. Wo sika ho ban yɛ den.
onboarding.bioFailed: Nsa nkyerɛwde no annye to mu. Bɔ mmɔden bio bere biara.
onboarding.teachBody: Ahyɛdeɛ mmiɛnsa. Ka: me sika a aka, na wote wo sika. Ka: kɔma sika, na wokɔma sika. Ka: gyae, na SafePay abu so.
onboarding.teachBalance: Ɛyɛ! Me sika a aka ne sika a ɛwɔ mu ahyɛdeɛ.
onboarding.teachSend: Ɛyɛ! Kɔma sika ne sika a wokɔma no ahyɛdeɛ.
onboarding.teachAgain: Bɔ mmɔden bio. Ahyɛdeɛ no ne: me sika a aka, kɔma sika, gyae.
onboarding.doneBody: SafePay asiesie. Wobɛtumi ate wo sika ne wo dwuma nyinaa, na wo PIN rennsɛ da. Ka me sika a aka, na wote wo sika.
onboarding.exited: Nhyehyɛeɛ no agyae. San fi aseɛ wɔ Settings mu.
